lyrics:
[Intro - Male Solo]
ମୋତେ ସପ୍ନ ଦେଖିବାକୁ ମନା ନାହିଁ
ମନା ନାହିଁ ମଝି ରାସ୍ତାରେ ହଜି ଜିବାକୁ
ଧୃବତାରା ଖୋଜିଦେବ ରାସ୍ତା ।

[Verse 1 - Male Solo]
ସାଉଁଟି... ସାଉଁଟି...
ଜାବୁଡି ଧରିଛି ସଂସାରକୁ
ଜୋଡି ଦେବାର ଆଶାରେ,
ସଜେଇ ଦେବାର ଆଶାରେ ।

[Verse 2 - Male Solo]
କୁଂଭକାର ମୁଁ ।

ଗଠିଦେବା ସିଖିଛି
ରଂଗେଈ ଦେଈ,
ତୁମ ମୁଖରେ ହସ ବୁଣିବା ସିଖିଛି ।

[Chorus - Male Lead]
ମୋତେ ସପ୍ନ ଦେଖିବାକୁ ମନା ନାହିଁ
ମନା ନାହିଁ ମଝି ରାସ୍ତାରେ ହଜି ଜିବାକୁ
ଧୃବତାରା ଖୋଜିଦେବ ରାସ୍ତା ।

[Bridge - Male Lead, Soft Female Responses]
ଆସ ପାହାଡ ଚଢିବା
ଆସ ଜନ୍ହ ଦେଖିବା
ବାଦଲ ସାଂଗେ କାଂଧ ମିଳେଈ
ଝଡିବାର ମଂତ୍ର ସିଖିବା ।

[Final Chorus - Male and Female Duet]
ମୋତେ ସପ୍ନ ଦେଖିବାକୁ ମନା ନାହିଁ ।
ମନା ନାହିଁ ଗୁଂଥିଦେବାକୁ
ତୁମ ସପ୍ନକୁ ମୋ ସପ୍ନରେ ।

[Soft Outro - Both Voices]
ମନା ନାହିଁ ଗୁଂଥିଦେବାକୁ
ତୁମ ସପ୍ନକୁ ମୋ ସପ୍ନରେ ।

settings.vocal_gender: Unselected; duet directed in lyrics and style

title: ମୋତେ ସପ୍ନ ଦେଖିବାକୁ ମନା ନାହିଁ — Soft Duet
style: Warm youthful male solo with soft female answering phrases, tender close-harmony duet at the end. Male sings the opening, all verses and first chorus. Female enters softly only at the mountain-and-moon invitation, offering brief replies behind the lead. Keep her delicate and supportive until the final refrain, when both voices blend intimately. Odia indie-folk ballad, natural Odia diction and complete words, flowing phrases with brief subtle Odissi-informed turns. Quiet acoustic guitar, bamboo flute, soft bass and restrained mardala. Calm soulful joy, affection and wonder. Spacious unhurried phrasing, sparse opening, gradually add warmth without speeding up. Distinct breath between the repeated gathering phrases; full pause after the potter declaration, soft instruments sustaining beneath. Use only supplied lyric words. Peaceful hopeful outro. No female-led verse, alternating lead verses, busy vocal counterpoint, driving beat, mournful delivery or dramatic crescendo.
changes: Restore male solo verses and first chorus, soft female answering phrases only at invitation, close-harmony duet at end
author_direction: male solo with soft female answering phrases, tender close-harmony duet at the end
